standard_prerequisites.name: Universal exactness of a short exact sequence and the criterion that a universally exact sequence of modules with the middle term as displayed splits

core_obligations: Set up the comparison: the proof chooses a presentation of the finitely presented module by a finite free module and a surjection onto the target from a possibly infinite free module, and a map of short exact sequences whose right vertical arrow is the given map (proof lines 4307-4322)

Form the pushout: the given map factors through the short exact sequence obtained as the pushout of the first sequence along the map of kernels, which is labelled as a displayed equation inside the proof (proof lines 4323-4328)

Compute the boundary: a diagram chase identifies the connecting map of the pushout sequence with the boundary map whose vanishing is assumed, so the pushout sequence is universally exact (proof lines 4329-4332)

Split and conclude: by the cross-chapter criterion a universally exact sequence of this shape splits, and the splitting exhibits the given map as factoring through the free module (proof lines 4332-4336)
proof_roadmap: 取 M 的自由表现 0 → K → R^{⊕r} → M → 0 与到 M' 的满射 0 → K' → ⊕_{i∈I}R → M' → 0，并构造两者之间的短正合列映射，右垂直箭头即给定映射。
把它沿 K → K' 做 pushout 得 0 → K' → E → M → 0；追图可知该序列的连接映射正是假设中消失的 Tor_1 边界映射，于是它普遍正合，从而分裂，M → M' 便通过自由模分解。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises, by the vanishing for every test module of the map induced on first Tor, those maps out of a finitely presented module that factor through a free module (author lemma at source lines 4298-4304, label lemma-map-tor-1-zero). The proof (source lines 4306-4337) builds a map of short exact sequences from a presentation of the source module and a free presentation of the target, forms the pushout along the map of kernels, and then does a diagram chase to identify the connecting map of the pushout sequence with the assumed-vanishing boundary map; universal exactness and the cross-chapter splitting criterion then give the factorisation (proof lines 4329-4336). The pushout construction with its diagram chase is the content, and the finite presentation hypothesis enters exactly at the splitting step. H2.
